نستصهن (form X)
# نَسْتَصْهِنُ (nastaṣhinu) /nas.tasˤ.hi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# نَسْتَصْهِنَ (nastaṣhina) /nas.tasˤ.hi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# نَسْتَصْهِنْ (nastaṣhin) /nas.tasˤ.hin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
